main_text.p: ceri ac effervescere : cibum per ean-em viam intestinum videlicet sensim ransire , ut bili & Succo Pancreatico ermisceatur ; bilis partes viscidiores c crassiores , id est , flavedinis inten-oris (quò enim ea dilutior est eò mi-us flavescit ) eadem post effervescen-am coagulari , ac fæces , cum quibus lis arctior nexus est infici ; chylum bicantem , à tota denique illa massa, uæ ex Triumviratu & cibo in stoma-ho costo componitur,tenuiorem hu-orem, vi motus peristalticivelut se-um ex caseo, secerni nitidum, purum c candidum , atque per venas Lacteas iasque vias ad Cor caeterasque huma-i corporis partes distribui. Easque ro diversitate suæ constitutionis aut aturaliter aut preternaturaliter affice-e , quæ quidem omnia tot manifestis rgumentis, rationibus & experimen-s demonstrata sunt, ut, qui hæc non atelligat,disciplinæ incapax videatur.

page.notes: The left edge of the scan is cut off, so many lines begin with word fragments, which are kept as printed. The start of the line "affice-e" is doubtful and may be a fragment of a longer word. The catchword "ne-" and the signature "H 2" are at the foot.
